review: Chorus is verse 2 (six lines, label 1), C repeats all six joined by " · "; label القرار stays as data. The 4/6/4/4/4 shape is the printed chorus stanza; short lines (1:3-1:4, 3:4, 2:1-2:2) stay short. The Arabic's dash in مديون – مديون is a repetition separator rendered with a comma, not a maqaf (house style). Parenthetical repeat marker 2 dropped; parentheses dropped. Glossary: חַיָּב for مديون (debt), חוֹבוֹתַי for ديوني, יָדִידִי for حبيبي, חֵרוּתִי for تحريري, עַבְדוּת for عبودية, רִבּוֹנִי for ربي, צְלָב for صليب, חַיֵּי עוֹלָם for حياة أبدية. 1:3-1:4 are one sentence split across two printed lines.
